rung_purposes.purpose: Set motor overload alarm when motor overload healthy signal is lost.
Reset general fault latch when fault reset pushbutton is pressed.
Aggregate faults and E-stop loss into a single fault flag.
Energize conveyor motor contactor in auto mode when no faults are present.
Indicate pallet is in position when pallet at stop photo-eye is blocked.
Latch stopper release solenoid on rising edge of release request.
Run a 2-second timer while the stopper release solenoid is energized.
Unlatch the stopper release solenoid when the 2-second timer completes.
